messages.author: f9e8a2dbcc79f890
messages.subject: fitList and occuFP error
parts:
I'm getting an error when I try to use fitList with occuFP objects.  I believe that fitList worked a couple months ago, but I updated to unmarked 0.10-2 a couple weeks ago and now I can't get it to work.  Here is an example:
 
#=============================================================
#---------- parameters--------------
n = 200; net = 2;  auc = 4;  p = .5;  r = .3;  fp = 0.1;  occ = 0.5  
# ------- true state ---------------- 
x <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)   
# ------- survey method ----------------
method <- matrix(c(rep(0,n*net), rep(1,n*auc)), nrow=n)
type <- c(net,auc,0)    
#-------  capture history ----------------
y = matrix(0, n, net+auc)
y[,1:net] <- rbinom(net*n, 1, x*r)      
y[which(x==1), (net+1):(net+auc)] <- rbinom((length(which(x==1))*auc), 1, p) 
y[which(x==0), (net+1):(net+auc)] <- rbinom((length(which(x==0))*auc), 1, fp) 
obs <- list(method=method)

#------- compile data and run model ----------------
umf1 <- unmarkedFrameOccuFP(y, obsCovs = obs, type = type)
m1 <- occuFP(detformula = ~ method, FPformula = ~1, stateformula = ~ 1, data = umf1)
models <- fitList(model1=m1)
#=============================================================
 
Error in model.frame(stateformula, siteCovs, na.action = NULL) :
  argument "stateformula" is missing, with no default
 
 
I don't have the same problem with 'occu':
#=============================================================
umf2 <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y, obsCovs = obs)
m2 <- occu(~1 ~1, data=umf2)
models2 <- fitList(model2=m2)
#=============================================================
Is this a bug or "user error"?  Thanks.
 
--Matt
